title: “Lovest Thou Me?”
author: Steven C. Barlow
notes_text: 2.  See Romans 8:35–39 ; Dale G. Renlund, “ Experience God’s Love ” (Brigham Young University devotional, Dec. 3, 2019), speeches.byu.edu; Russell M. Nelson, “ Divine Love ,” Ensign , Feb. 2003, 20–25; Liahona , Feb. 2023, 12–17.
9.  While we don’t earn God’s love through our actions, He is eager to acknowledge our expressions of love to Him by hearing our prayers, blessing us, and helping us experience His love for us.

11. “We must put God in the forefront of everything else in our lives. He must come first. … “When we put God first, all other things fall into their proper place or drop out of our lives. Our love of the Lord will govern the claims for our affection, the demands on our time, the interests we pursue, and the order of our priorities” ( Teachings of Presidents of the Church: Ezra Taft Benson [2014], 40). See also Dallin H. Oaks, “ Good, Better, Best ,” Ensign or Liahona , Nov. 2007, 104–8.
12. Russell M. Nelson, “ Let God Prevail ,” Ensign or Liahona , Nov. 2020, 94.
18. Thomas S. Monson, “ An Attitude of Gratitude ,” Ensign , May 1992, 54.
20. Tamara W. Runia, “ Your Repentance Doesn’t Burden Jesus Christ; It Brightens His Joy ,” Liahona , May 2025, 92.
23. “Know This, That Every Soul Is Free,” Hymns , no. 240.
25. Dale G. Renlund, “ Choose You This Day ,” Ensign or Liahona , Nov. 2018, 104.
26. See Patrick Kearon, “ Receive His Gift ,” Liahona , May 2025, 121–24.

27. “The first great commandment of all eternity is to love God with all of our heart, might, mind, and strength—that’s the first great commandment. But the first great truth of all eternity is that God loves us with all of His heart, might, mind, and strength” (Jeffrey R. Holland, “ Tomorrow the Lord Will Do Wonders Among You ,” Ensign or Liahona , May 2016, 127).

28. “ Hesed is a special kind of love and mercy that God feels for and extends to those who have made a covenant with Him. And we reciprocate with hesed for Him. “Because God has hesed for those who have covenanted with Him, He will love them. He will continue to work with them and offer them opportunities to change. He will forgive them when they repent. And should they stray, He will help them find their way back to Him. “Once you and I have made a covenant with God, our relationship with Him becomes much closer than before our covenant” (Russell M. Nelson, “ The Everlasting Covenant ,” Liahona , Oct. 2022, 6).
